rows.grounds: temporal adverb indicating sequence after the preceding action
adverb indicating the subsequent step in the sequence
yogic practice named as the next action

items.question: What practice must follow the initial tenfold recitation?
premises: The initial tenfold recitation has already been prescribed.
A subsequent practice is enjoined after that recitation.
Breath-control is named as that subsequent practice.
items.inference: After the initial tenfold recitation, one must perform breath-control.
items.plain_english: Then next, O great goddess, O beautiful-faced one, perform breath-control.
